name: retrieve_and_halve_value
description: Calls another routine to get a 16-bit value and returns it shifted right by one bit, which halves it. It is only reached through a pointer stored in the data hunk.

name: lookup_scaled_squared_length
description: Sums the squares of three signed 16-bit components, then uses the total to pick a lookup-table entry, with the index shift depending on the total's range. The table value is shifted right by a range-dependent amount and returned.

name: lookup_table_value_by_magnitude
description: Takes a 32-bit value and chooses a table index and a shift according to which magnitude range it falls in, then returns the table entry shifted right. Several routines and handler pointers call it.

name: fetch_halved_table_word
description: Turns the input, shifted right by two and masked to an even value, into a shared lookup-table offset, then returns the stored word shifted right by one bit.

name: fetch_table_word_by_index
description: Converts the 16-bit input, shifted right by four and masked to an even value, into a lookup-table offset and returns the word stored there without scaling.

name: lookup_long_value_by_range
description: Chooses one of three table lookups for a 32-bit input based on its magnitude range, each with its own index derivation and shift, and returns the 16-bit entry. One routine calls it.

name: lookup_high_range_value
description: Converts a 32-bit input into a table offset by swapping its halves and shifting left by two, then returns the stored word shifted right by three. It has no range checks and covers only one branch of the magnitude lookup.

name: lookup_wide_range_value
description: Converts a 32-bit input into a table offset by swapping its halves and shifting left by six, then returns the stored word shifted right by five. It has no range checks and one routine calls it.

name: dot_vector_with_two_columns
description: Multiplies a three-component vector held in registers by memory words at offsets 0, 3, 6 and 1, 4, 7, doubling each sum. Both 32-bit results are packed into one 64-bit return value.

name: dot_vector_with_two_rows
description: Forms two sums of products between a three-component register vector and the first two consecutive three-word groups in memory, doubling each sum. Both results are packed into one 64-bit return value.

name: build_rotation_matrix_from_angles
description: Looks up sine-like values for two angle inputs in the shared table, using a table index offset of a quarter turn for one of them and negating values by their sign bit. It stores the doubled products in a 3x3 output array and clears the last element.

name: build_matrix_from_table_and_stack
description: Builds a 3x3 matrix in the output array from one register-indexed table value and two stack arguments, applying signed table lookups to the remaining entries. The last element is cleared.

name: build_matrix_from_partial_lookup
description: Builds a 3x3 output matrix from two stack arguments and one table value indexed by a register, with another entry taken directly from a register. The last element is cleared.

name: build_matrix_from_direct_pair
description: Fills a 3x3 matrix in memory with products of two register values and a sign-adjusted table lookup selected by a third register. Two entries are stored as direct register values and the last element is cleared.

name: fill_matrix_from_registers_and_table
description: Stores a 3x3 matrix whose entries are doubled products of register inputs, with one table lookup indexed by a register supplying a shared factor. The last element is cleared.

name: build_rotation_matrix_negated_layout
description: Builds a 3x3 rotation-style matrix from sine and cosine lookups of two angle inputs, with negated entries in some positions. Products are doubled and their high words kept, and one element is cleared.

name: build_rotation_matrix_stack_args
description: Builds a 3x3 rotation-style matrix like its neighbour, but takes its angle values from stack arguments and a register-indexed table entry. Negated entries sit in alternate positions and one element is cleared.

name: build_matrix_from_stack_and_register
description: Builds a 3x3 matrix from two stack-supplied angle values, one register value and one table lookup, storing negated products in alternate positions. One element is cleared.

name: build_matrix_from_register_pair
description: Builds a 3x3 matrix from two register values and a table lookup, storing negated products in alternate positions with one element cleared. The angle inputs here come from registers rather than the stack.

name: build_negated_matrix_from_registers
description: Builds a 3x3 matrix from register inputs and a table lookup selected by a register, with negated entries in several positions and one cleared element. It writes all nine output words.

name: compute_sine_cosine_product_pair
description: Looks up signed sine-like and cosine-like table values for two angle inputs, forms products of them, and packs two results into one 64-bit return value. One result has its sign inverted.

name: compute_signed_table_product_pair
description: Looks up signed table values for two register angles and an unsigned table index for a third, forms products from them, and returns two packed results in one 64-bit value.

name: scale_register_by_table_product
description: Looks up two table entries from register indices, applying the sign bit to one of them, then forms a doubled product with a register value and a plain product of the two entries. Both results are packed into a 64-bit return value.

name: multiply_registers_by_table_entry
description: Forms a doubled product of two register values and a second product of one register with a sign-adjusted table entry. Both results are packed into a 64-bit return value.

name: multiply_pair_with_table_entry
description: Forms a doubled product of two register values and a second product of one register with an unsigned table entry. Both results are packed into a 64-bit return value.

name: clip_point_pair_to_bounds
description: Steps a point pair toward a screen-like area using halving fixed-point increments, testing against limits of 319 and 168. The clipped coordinates are returned packed into a 64-bit value.

name: clamp_point_steps_to_limit
description: Steps a point pair with halving increments until one coordinate falls inside a limit of 168, then returns the clipped pair packed into a 64-bit value. It is a second pass of the same bounding idea.

name: step_fixed_point_pair_to_end
description: Repeatedly halves two increments and adds them to a fixed-point coordinate pair until the step size drops below a threshold. The rounded pair is returned as one 64-bit value.

name: clip_point_pair_against_height
description: Steps a point pair with halving fixed-point increments until a coordinate lies inside a limit of 169, returning the clipped pair in one 64-bit value. Its limit check and direction differ from the nearby clip routines.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: This routine contains only a return and does nothing. It is a stub, so there is no behaviour to describe.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: This routine contains only a return and does nothing. It is a stub, so there is no behaviour to describe.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: This routine contains only a return and does nothing. It is a stub, so there is no behaviour to describe.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: This routine contains only a return and does nothing. It is a stub, so there is no behaviour to describe.

name: rotate_vector_pair_by_angle
description: Rotates two three-component vectors in memory by a sine-like and a cosine-like value derived from a register angle, writing the doubled results back in place. Each vector's components are mixed with those of the other.

name: rotate_vector_pair_table_angle
description: Rotates two three-component vectors in memory using sine-like and cosine-like values taken from a table indexed by a register, writing the doubled results back in place.

name: rotate_vector_pair_by_coefficients
description: Applies a rotation to two three-component vectors in memory, using one register value and one table entry as the coefficients. The doubled results are written back into the same vectors.

name: insert_sorted_tree_node
description: Walks a binary tree of nodes keyed by a 32-bit value and attaches the new node at its sorted position. It sets the new node's key and clears its two child links.

name: insert_tree_node_under_node
description: Descends from a given tree node, choosing a child by comparing a 32-bit key, and attaches the new node at the first empty child. It sets the new node's key and clears its child links.

name: initialize_node_pool
description: Initializes a node pool at startup by clearing a global counter, storing the head node's address in a global, and writing a sentinel and constants into the head node and other globals.

name: reset_pool_head_node
description: Resets the head node of the same pool and rewrites the same global constants, clearing a global first. It repeats the initialization sequence, so it works as a reset rather than a first-time setup.

name: set_global_pointers_to_stack_buffer
description: Points three global pointers at the address of a large local stack buffer. It takes no inputs and returns nothing.

name: dispatch_node_callbacks_loop
description: Walks a linked node list from a base address and calls a handler for each node, looked up through an offset table. The loop repeats indefinitely, and each node stores its handler index as a 16-bit value.

name: dispatch_node_callbacks_from_head
description: Runs the same node-walking dispatch loop, starting from the list head held in a global. Each node's handler is found from a 16-bit offset stored in the node.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: This routine contains only a return and does nothing. It is a stub, so there is no behaviour to describe.

name: refresh_cached_matrix_product
description: When a cached flag byte in the object differs from the global value, it multiplies the object's 3x3 matrix by three vectors from a source matrix and stores the nine doubled results in the object. It then updates the cached flag.

name: transform_scaled_fixed_vector
description: Reads three 64-bit fixed-point components from the object and shifts them down by a count that lets them fit in 16 bits. It multiplies them by a 3x3 matrix in memory, shifts the products back into 64-bit results, and sets the object's flag byte.

name: transform_scaled_parameter_vector
description: Scales 64-bit parameter components down to 16-bit range using a shift count from the stack, then multiplies them by a 3x3 matrix in memory. The shifted products are stored in the object as 64-bit results and its flag byte is set.

name: store_shifted_components_with_carry
description: Shifts three register components right by a count and adds them to parameter values, storing the 64-bit sums with carry into the object. It also updates the object's flag byte.

name: get_cached_transformed_vector
description: Returns a cached 64-bit result from the object when its flag byte matches the global value. Otherwise it recomputes the value, either by transforming the stored fixed-point vector or by adding a new delta, and updates the cache.

name: get_cached_vector_by_register_flag
description: Uses the same caching logic as its neighbour, but its freshness check compares the object's flag byte with a byte passed in a register rather than the global. On a miss it recomputes the value and updates the cache.

name: return_cached_64bit_result
description: Returns the 64-bit value stored at a fixed offset in the object. It performs no computation.

name: copy_source_vector_to_cache
description: Copies six 32-bit values from the object's source block into its cache block and sets the flag byte to the global value. It then returns.

name: compute_vector_difference_cached
description: Returns the 64-bit difference between two objects' vectors, using their source values when the flag bytes match and cached values otherwise. When a flag comparison shows the second object is in a particular state, it returns the negated source value instead.

name: subtract_source_or_cached_vector
description: Returns the difference between the object's source vector and the other object's source vector when their flag bytes match. Otherwise it fetches a fresh value and subtracts the other object's cached value.

name: return_negated_source_pair
description: Negates two 32-bit values from offsets in the object and packs them into one 64-bit return value.

name: store_scaled_field_and_call
description: Shifts a 16-bit field from one structure left by a count held in the frame, doubles it and stores it in the frame. It also finds a power-of-two normalization count for another value, then calls another routine.

name: store_high_byte_and_call
description: Takes the high byte of a 16-bit field from one structure, stores it in a frame slot, and then calls another routine. Nothing else is done.

name: compute_bit_shift_flag_byte
description: Shifts a single bit left by the difference between a register value and a 16-bit field in a structure, clamping a negative result to a maximum byte. It stores that byte and a fixed sentinel pair in another structure.

name: scale_vector_and_test_threshold
description: Scales a 64-bit vector down to 16-bit range using a shift count, then compares the result with a per-object threshold from a table. Depending on the test it stores a clipped value and sentinels, or matrix products, and may write a fixed command word into a queue.

name: compute_projection_with_flag_sources
description: Derives a scaling count from a 16-bit field, shifts a fixed vector by that count and multiplies it by a 3x3 matrix. The matrix comes from one of two sources selected by flag bytes, and the scaled results or sentinels are written into the object.

name: update_projection_matrix_cache
description: Multiplies the object's 3x3 matrix by a fixed vector and tests the scaled sum for zero. A nonzero sum stores sentinel values, while a zero sum calls further routines and writes matrix products into a frame area.

name: multiply_matrix_block_into_frame
description: Multiplies a 3x3 matrix taken from a structure at a fixed offset by the rows of another matrix, storing the doubled products in a frame area. It then calls two routines and writes a command word into a queue when a flag is set.

name: multiply_matrix_pair_into_frame
description: Multiplies two 3x3 matrices stored in memory and writes the doubled products into a frame area. The second matrix pointer is adjusted by a flag first, and a queue word may be written afterwards.

name: copy_or_multiply_matrix_into_frame
description: Sets two sentinel values in an object, then either copies a 3x3 matrix into a frame area or multiplies it with another matrix, depending on flag bytes. It then calls further routines.

name: flush_pending_command_word
description: Calls a routine, then if a pending flag is set writes a fixed command word into a queue and clears the flag. The branch is always taken, so the queue write depends only on the pending flag.

name: advance_command_queue_pointer
description: Calls two routines and then, when a pending flag is set, appends a fixed command word to a queue and advances the queue pointer. The flag is cleared afterwards.

name: queue_command_word_and_return
description: Calls routines and, when a pending flag is set, appends a fixed command word to the queue and clears the flag before returning.

name: normalize_and_transform_vector_frame
description: Finds a shift count that fits three 64-bit inputs into a 16-bit range, shifts and negates them, and multiplies them by two 3x3 matrices. The results are stored in the local frame as fixed-point values.

name: compute_clip_margin_value
description: Scales a 16-bit field from a structure by a shift count and compares it with frame-stored components. It returns a clipped margin value, or zero when the components fail the comparisons.

name: clear_strided_word_block
description: Zeroes two words per row in a strided table, with the row count taken from a field of another structure divided by 64. Each row is 32 words apart.

name: clear_structured_memory
description: Zeroes five fields of a structure, then clears two words per row across a strided table, using a count taken from a register input. It is the register-driven counterpart of its neighbour.

name: fill_stack_buffer_with_constant
description: Fills a stack buffer with a fixed word value. The word count is a field in a structure halved and reduced by three, and nothing is written when that count is negative.

name: emit_projected_billboard_record
description: Returns early when the point lies outside the screen limits of 319 and 167. Otherwise it projects a scaled quad around the point using divisions, and writes a 41-word output record with cached table indices into the output list.

name: emit_projected_billboard_offset
description: Projects a scaled quad like its neighbour, but starts from the point offset by an extra register value, and checks the same screen limits. It writes the same 41-word output record with cached table indices.

name: emit_projected_billboard_fallback
description: Projects a quad like its neighbours, but when the early-exit test fails it takes a fallback path that moves the corner coordinates by one step before the shared tail. Otherwise it writes the same 41-word output record.

name: emit_projected_billboard_stack_args
description: Projects a scaled quad around a point given as stack arguments and writes a 41-word output record with cached table indices into the output list. It performs no screen-limit test.

name: emit_projected_billboard_checked
description: Writes the same kind of 41-word projected quad record as its neighbour, starting from stack-argument coordinates. It calls the shared helpers and stores the corner points in the output list.

name: emit_cached_index_record
description: Stores a cache index for a value in the output record, allocating a new slot in the shared index table when none exists, and writes a 16-bit cached value into the record. It is one of several record writers in this group.

name: emit_indexed_point_record
description: Writes a value and a coordinate pair into the output record with a cached index, advancing the record pointer by four bytes. It then looks up a second cached index for the same record.

name: emit_cached_index_projected_quad
description: Stores a cached index and then projects a scaled quad from stack-argument coordinates, writing the corner points into the output record. Its divisions use a size from a helper routine.

name: emit_indexed_projected_quad
description: Writes a cached index and advances the record pointer like its neighbour, then projects a scaled quad from the input point using divisions by a helper value. The corner points are written into the output record.

name: emit_clipped_quad_with_angle
description: Adjusts a field by a scaled value when a second input is in range, then computes corner points one step inside the input coordinates. It derives a table index from a scaled division and writes the resulting record.

name: emit_quad_corners_table_index
description: Computes corner points one step inside the input coordinates and derives a table index from the low bits of a register value. It writes the corner points and index into the output record.

name: emit_tagged_label_record
description: Writes a six-word output record tagged with one of two fixed values depending on a flag byte. Coordinates are reduced by one when the flag is set, and a cached index is stored in the record.

name: emit_tagged_label_record_calls
description: Writes the same tagged six-word output record as its neighbour, then calls further routines to finish the entry.

name: emit_two_cached_indices_record
description: Stores a cache index for a register value in the output record, then derives a second cache index from a masked register value offset by a fixed base. Each index is cached in the shared table when it is new.

name: append_coordinate_and_cache_index
description: Appends an entry to the output list by advancing a pointer by four bytes and storing a value in the record. It then derives and caches a second index from a masked register value.

name: store_cached_index_at_offset
description: Caches a register-supplied index in the shared table if there is room, and writes the result into a fixed field of the output record. Nothing else is done.

name: append_value_to_output_list
description: Appends a value to the output list by advancing a pointer by four bytes and writes the value into a fixed field of the record.

name: emit_tagged_quotient_record
description: Computes a scaled quotient from a stored 32-bit value and a shift. When the quotient is zero it writes a five-word record tagged with a fixed value and the coordinates, and caches an index for it; otherwise it takes a different path.

name: emit_tagged_quotient_register_record
description: Computes a quotient from a register value and a stored divisor, and when the quotient is zero writes a tagged five-word record with the coordinates and a cached index. Otherwise it takes a second path.

name: emit_bounded_quotient_record
description: When a flag byte is set, computes a scaled quotient and writes a record only when the point is below 320 horizontally and below 168 vertically. Otherwise it returns without output.

name: emit_tagged_point_record
description: Writes a five-word record tagged with a fixed value, holding two coordinates and a fixed field, then caches an index for the record.

name: emit_tagged_point_record_calls
description: Writes the same five-word tagged record as its neighbour, with the first coordinate coming from a routine call, and caches an index for the record.

name: store_cached_index_field
description: Caches a register-supplied index in the shared table when there is room, and writes the result into offset two of the output record.

name: append_value_to_list_offset_two
description: Appends a value to the output list by advancing a pointer by four bytes, and stores the value at offset two of the record.

name: interpolate_table_coefficients_span
description: Uses bits of a register value to index a coefficient table and combines the entries with values held in the frame. When a flag bit is clear it uses a direct value instead, and it writes the interpolated result back through a pointer.

name: resolve_indirect_table_value
description: Reads a 16-bit value through a pointer and, depending on a bit in it, either shifts the value or fetches it from a frame-relative table. It then combines the result with coefficient entries to produce a 16-bit output.

name: fetch_frame_or_table_value
description: Chooses between a frame-stored value and a table entry according to a bit of a register value. It uses the result to look up a coefficient and combine it with the register values, returning a 16-bit value.

name: combine_frame_value_with_coefficient
description: Loads a frame-stored value at a register offset, looks up a coefficient for it, and combines both with a sign applied when the top bit is set. It produces a 16-bit result.

name: scale_frame_pair_with_table_sign
description: Looks up a sign-adjusted coefficient for each of two components of a register-indexed structure entry. It combines them with a shifted pair stored in the frame and returns the scaled results.

name: compute_frame_offset_product_sum
description: Looks up a coefficient from a table pair and combines two frame-stored triples by multiplying each with register values. The doubled sum is stored in a frame slot.

name: set_global_flag_to_ff
description: Writes the value 255 to a global and returns. The global's name is not recovered from the executable.

name: identify_unrecovered_routine_timeout
description: The decompiler timed out on this routine, so no pseudo-code is available. Its facts show it is called by two routines and calls two routines, but its purpose cannot be determined from the evidence.

name: setup_scaled_callback_buffer
description: Sets up a 49-word stack buffer and offsets from a structure, scales three fields by a shift when a count applies, and calls routines through indexed slots in the buffer. It records a state byte before finishing.

name: setup_scaled_callback_buffer_arg
description: Like its neighbour, sets up a 49-word stack buffer from a structure and an argument, scales fields by a shift, and calls routines through slots in the buffer.

name: dispatch_handler_by_table_index
description: Looks up a handler address in a table using an offset derived from a register value, calls that handler, and returns.

name: dispatch_by_encoded_index
description: Decodes a 16-bit value to choose between two indirect call paths and a data-pointer path. It calls the chosen handler and then returns.

name: decompress_byte_stream_runs
description: Copies bytes from a compressed source into the destination, expanding runs when a byte is above a threshold and a control value triggers a nested call. It stops at a zero byte.

name: decompress_byte_stream_from_offset
description: Starts a byte-stream decoder at a pointer formed by adding a 16-bit offset to a base address, then copies bytes and expands control codes as its neighbours do. It stops at a zero byte.

name: expand_control_coded_stream
description: Walks a control-coded byte stream, copying literal bytes and expanding marker codes into two-byte pairs or into calls to a helper routine.

name: emit_marker_code_bytes
description: Writes a marker byte followed by one or two data bytes, depending on the input byte value, and calls a helper for one special input value. It advances both the output and input pointers.

name: emit_marker_then_copy_string
description: Writes a marker byte and one data byte, then copies a zero-terminated run of bytes from the source to the destination, returning when the terminator is reached.

name: emit_helper_then_copy_string
description: Calls a helper to reserve output space, then copies a zero-terminated run of bytes from the source, handling marker bytes that appear within it.

name: dispatch_indirect_slot_call
description: Uses a bit field of a register value to pick a function pointer from a structure slot, then calls it through that pointer.

name: measure_text_width_until_limit
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string, subtracting a per-character table value from a running width until the terminator or a limit is reached. A byte with value 13 is handled as a special case.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: This routine contains only a return and does nothing. It is a stub, so there is no behaviour to describe.

name: scan_object_slots_for_match
description: Sets several state bytes and a sentinel, then scans a table of slot indices from 114 down to zero. It skips entries whose flag bits fail, compares the candidate's type and flag fields with a reference object, and returns a packed status word.

name: scan_object_slots_with_flag_reset
description: Like its neighbour, it scans slot indices downward from 114 and compares candidates with a reference object, but it starts from a different state byte. It returns a packed status word when the scan ends.

name: scan_object_slots_from_reference
description: Scans the table of slot indices downward for entries that pass a flag test and differ from a stored index byte, comparing candidate fields with the reference object. It returns a packed status word.

name: find_next_valid_entity
description: Repeatedly fetches an entity from a table and walks slot indices downward, skipping entries that have one flag bit set or that match a stored index byte. When the slots run out it returns a packed status word.

name: test_object_proximity_and_collect
description: Computes a squared length from three signed components using sums of products, and compares it with radius values stored in the two objects. When the objects overlap it walks a table of candidates and returns a flag byte.

name: compute_integer_square_root_distance
description: Shifts three components and an offset into range, sums their squared magnitudes, and runs a bitwise integer square-root loop when the result exceeds a threshold. It sets a status bit in the frame and returns a flag byte.

name: compute_bitwise_square_root_five_inputs
description: Negates five signed input components as needed and sums their squared magnitudes together with two object offsets. It then runs a bitwise square-root loop and sets a status bit when the result exceeds a threshold, returning a flag byte.

name: apply_rotation_and_scale
description: Copies components from its parameters into the output structure, looks up a table value and adjusts a scale, then calls helper routines to finish the entry. Its shifted values are written as fixed-point words.

name: compute_sqrt_and_subtract
description: Runs a bitwise square-root loop on a register value, then subtracts a parameter from the result. A negative difference is handled separately, and a status bit is set in the frame.

name: stub_returns_zero
description: This routine only returns zero. It does no other work.

name: scan_slots_and_record_hit
description: Clears a state byte, reads a table entry for the object, and walks slot indices downward. It calls helpers and records the best match in frame slots, returning a byte flag.

name: negate_halved_object_fields
description: Halves and negates three 32-bit fields in the object, then calls a handler when a 16-bit field exceeds 16. It returns a status byte from the frame.

name: accumulate_scaled_table_terms
description: Walks a list of table-indexed terms, multiplies each by a signed coefficient, shifts it by a count from the frame, and adds it to a running sum. It returns a status byte from the frame.

name: return_frame_status_byte
description: Returns a status byte stored in the frame. Nothing else is done.

name: interpret_scaled_bytecode_terms
description: Reads a bytecode stream from a structure and scales a register value by a shift derived from its magnitude. It accumulates per-term results and returns a 64-bit status value.

name: transform_object_vectors_by_matrix
description: Multiplies the rows of a 3x3 matrix taken from a second object by fixed-point components from a register, storing doubled results as words. It is applied when a flag byte matches, and a bytecode stream is read otherwise.

name: transform_vector_by_object_matrix
description: Multiplies a 3x3 matrix from a second object by a register vector and stores the doubled rows as words. It then continues with a bytecode-driven loop like its neighbours.

name: run_bytecode_flag_commands
description: Reads command bytes from a stream, using flag bits to decide whether to store a value pair or call helper routines. It returns a 64-bit status value.

name: run_bitmasked_bytecode_commands
description: Tests a bit of a register value to decide whether to run a bytecode command stream, then processes the commands and calls helpers for some flag combinations. It stores a status byte in the frame.

name: stub_returns_constant
description: Returns a fixed 64-bit constant with no other work. It is a stub.

name: run_zero_terminated_command_list
description: Walks a zero-terminated list of command bytes, calling helpers for each entry. It then sets a flag bit in the frame and returns a packed 64-bit status.

name: run_zero_terminated_command_pairs
description: Walks a zero-terminated list of command bytes, then a second group of paired bytes, calling helpers for each one. It stores a frame flag and returns a packed 64-bit status.

name: run_bytecode_helper_commands
description: Processes a bytecode stream in which flag bits select between a helper call and a stored value, and updates a status byte in the frame. It is a variant of its neighbours.

name: run_bytecode_pair_stream
description: Reads paired bytes from a command stream and stores each into a structure slot, stopping at a zero byte. It returns a 64-bit status value.

name: apply_table_transform_to_points
description: Looks up a table entry for a structure, computes three offsets from its fields, and applies them with scaling to a set of coordinate words. The transformed words are written to output memory.

name: subtract_shifted_offsets_from_vector
description: Shifts three register offsets by a count when a flag is clear, then subtracts them from the words at a source address. The results are stored with sign handling, walking the structure words in turn.

name: store_signed_values_by_table_offsets
description: Stores signed register values into structure slots whose offsets come from a table indexed by three bits of a register. Bit flags decide whether each value is negated first.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: This routine contains only a return and does nothing. It is a stub, so there is no behaviour to describe.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: This routine contains only a return and does nothing. It is a stub, so there is no behaviour to describe.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: This routine contains only a return and does nothing. It is a stub, so there is no behaviour to describe.

name: transpose_and_negate_matrix_entries
description: Swaps matrix entries across the diagonal in place, then negates the first and fourth words. The matrix is stored as nine words in the object.

name: permute_matrix_entries_in_place
description: Rearranges eight words of a 3x3 matrix in place, moving entries across the diagonal and leaving the others fixed.

name: transform_object_matrix_with_offsets
description: Combines the object's stored fixed-point components with a second matrix in memory using shifted products, and writes six 32-bit results back to the object. It calls a helper for normalization.

name: transform_parameters_into_object_matrix
description: Scales input parameters down by a shift count derived from their magnitude, multiplies them by a 3x3 matrix in memory, and writes the shifted products into the object as 64-bit values.

name: store_shifted_vector_and_transform
description: Shifts three register values into 64-bit object fields, extends their sign words, then multiplies a matrix block and writes the scaled products.

name: transform_object_matrix_negated
description: Transforms the object's fixed-point components against a second matrix, negating some terms by their sign, and writes six 32-bit results back. It calls a helper for normalization.

name: transform_stack_vector_into_matrix
description: Scales parameter values from registers and the stack by a shift count, multiplies them by a 3x3 matrix in memory, and stores the scaled products with rounding into the output.

name: store_shifted_and_copy_matrix_rows
description: Stores shifted input values into the object's 64-bit fields, calls a helper, then copies three matrix rows into the output words.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: This routine contains only a return and does nothing. It is a stub, so there is no behaviour to describe.

name: find_sorted_list_position
description: Walks a linked list of 12-byte entries ordered by a 16-bit key to find where a given key belongs. It leaves the preceding entry in a register.

name: insert_or_update_keyed_entry
description: Walks the flagged entries of an ordered list and inserts a new 12-byte entry when no entry has the same key. It takes the node from the free pointer and sets flag bits on the new entry.

name: allocate_list_node_with_key
description: Takes a node from the free-space pointer of a 12-byte entry table, stores a 16-bit key and a value in it, and links it into the ordered list. Its flag byte is set to a fixed value.

name: allocate_node_copy_from_entry
description: Allocates a node from the free pointer when a flag allows, copies the key and flags from an existing entry, and links the new node into the list.

name: walk_list_to_key_position
description: Walks the ordered list forward from a starting entry, skipping entries whose flag bit is clear, until it finds one whose key is greater than the search key. It returns that position.

name: store_node_key_and_vector
description: Writes a 16-bit key and three register values into the node at a computed offset in the entry table. It links the node into the list when the zero flag is set.

name: allocate_node_from_free_pointer
description: Takes the next free node when a flag allows, writes its key, copies flags from an existing entry, and links it into the list.

name: find_sorted_list_position_alt
description: Walks an ordered list of 12-byte entries from a head pointer to find the position for a 16-bit key. It leaves the preceding entry in a register.

name: fill_list_node_if_flagged
description: Advances through the ordered list until a key is reached, and when that entry has a flag bit set it writes a fixed value and a marker byte into it. Otherwise it returns without change.

name: walk_list_for_key_range
description: Walks the list comparing 16-bit keys against a lower and an upper bound, following flagged entries and calling helpers to link nodes that fall within the range.

name: insert_key_into_flagged_list
description: Walks the ordered list and inserts a new key node when the key falls between existing keys. The node is taken from the free pointer and linked into the list.

name: insert_key_node_at_position
description: Inserts a new node carrying a 16-bit key after the given position, taking it from the free pointer, when the key differs from the entry already there.

name: allocate_node_with_flag_value
description: Takes a node from the free pointer when a flag allows, writes its key and a fixed flag word, and links it into the ordered list.

name: transform_object_vector_fixed_point
description: Loads matrix and vector words for the object and applies fixed-point multiplications and shifts, writing the results to memory.

name: transform_scaled_inputs_by_matrix
description: Shifts three input values by a count derived from their magnitude, multiplies them by a 3x3 matrix from an object, and writes the scaled sums out.

name: store_shifted_vector_to_frame
description: Shifts three register values right by a count and stores them in frame slots, along with three sign words. It is a helper for the transform routines around it.

name: transform_frame_vector_by_matrix
description: Loads frame-stored components and matrix words from a structure, applies fixed-point multiplications and shifts, and writes the results back to memory.

name: transform_shifted_inputs_by_columns
description: Shifts three input values by a count derived from their magnitude, multiplies them against matrix columns from a structure, and writes the scaled sums.

name: store_shifted_vector_and_signs
description: Stores three shifted register values and their sign words into a second frame area.

name: combine_pair_of_64bit_vectors
description: Loads six 32-bit values from a structure and combines them with signed sums and carry handling, returning a 64-bit result.

name: multiply_shifted_inputs_by_matrix_rows
description: Shifts three inputs by a count derived from their magnitude, then forms products with two rows of a 3x3 matrix from memory. The result is returned as a 64-bit value.

name: return_shifted_pair
description: Shifts two register values right by a count and returns them packed into a 64-bit value.

name: update_object_pair_state_loop
description: Subtracts one object's 32-bit position from another's with borrow, then loops over a count using the results and calls a helper at each step. It clears a frame slot and returns a status byte.

name: store_frame_state_and_process
description: Copies register-supplied values into frame slots as object state, then runs a loop over the object's fields using helper calls. It returns a status byte.

name: save_frame_state_and_process
description: Stores register values and 32-bit inputs into frame slots, then calls several helpers to process the stored state. It returns a status byte.

name: process_flagged_frame_state
description: Tests a frame flag bit and, when it is set and the object is not in the sentinel state, updates frame-stored values from a structure. It then runs a loop of helper calls and returns a status byte.

name: update_flagged_frame_values
description: Tests a frame flag bit and, when set and the state byte is not the sentinel, reads frame values and a structure pointer to update the object. It returns a status byte.

name: run_object_state_loop
description: Clears a frame byte and runs a loop that compares object state bytes, calling helpers for each matching object. It returns a status byte.

name: match_object_state_bytes
description: Compares object type bytes and a frame byte against a reference object, updating a frame flag when they match. Helper routines are called for matching entries.

name: run_object_state_loop_alt
description: Clears a frame byte and runs a loop of helper calls over object state, similar to its neighbour, and returns a status byte.

name: set_pair_state_flag
description: Sets or clears a frame flag byte from the object's flag, then runs a comparison loop over object state bytes, calling helpers on matches. It returns a status byte.

name: clear_flag_and_compare_states
description: Clears a frame flag byte and runs a loop over objects, comparing state bytes and calling helpers on matches. It returns a status byte.

name: compare_indexed_object_states
description: Derives an indexed object pointer from a state byte and compares the object's type byte with a register value, calling helper routines when fields match. It returns a status byte.

name: clear_flag_and_compare_states_alt
description: Clears a frame flag byte and runs the same object state comparison loop as its neighbours, calling helpers on matches. It returns a status byte.

name: clear_flag_after_helper_call
description: Calls a helper when a flag byte is set, clears a frame flag, then continues the state comparison loop. It returns a status byte.

name: clear_flag_and_compare_states_b
description: Clears a frame flag byte and runs the object state comparison loop, calling helpers on matches. It returns a status byte.

name: compare_states_with_register_byte
description: Compares a register byte with an object type byte, clearing a frame flag on a match. Otherwise it continues the state loop with helper calls.

name: clear_flag_and_compare_states_c
description: Clears a frame flag byte and runs the object state comparison loop, calling helpers on matches. It returns a status byte.

name: clear_flag_then_state_loop
description: Clears a frame flag byte and runs the object state loop, calling helpers on matches. It returns a status byte.

name: update_frame_values_when_flagged
description: Tests a frame flag and, when the state byte is not the sentinel, reads frame values and a structure pointer to update the object. It returns a status byte.

name: store_helper_result_and_flags
description: Stores a helper result and register values into frame slots, then branches on an object flag bit. It returns a status byte.

name: return_halved_frame_pair
description: Reads two 32-bit frame values, calls a helper, and returns both halved as words packed into a 64-bit value.

name: transform_frame_values_by_object
description: Loads frame-stored values and an object pointer, and when the object's flag is set applies a flag-dependent update. It returns a 32-bit status value.

name: transform_matrix_row_pair
description: Multiplies three register values by two rows of a 3x3 matrix in a structure, shifting and packing the sums. The scaled results are returned as a 64-bit value.
